request.summary: Full Harbor validation is blocked by a reproducible static metadata error: the CLI reports 'component Harbor metadata ... requires target_import_path' although the field exists. Both the file path and dotted entrypoint forms produced the identical error before any trial. No model failure has been measured.
steps: Repair or update the RELAI CLI static Harbor metadata validator to support target_type = "agent" with component_adapter_asset, as permitted by the agent-test contract, and to retain/read its target_import_path.

Inspect the staged task.toml at .relai/harbor/agent-tests/.stage-20261020T032138.800Z-63130: [metadata.relai] already declares target_import_path = "paid_seat_candidate.stream_agent_response" and component_adapter_asset = "environment/candidate_adapter.json". The adapter explicitly imports only /workspace/demo/scenarios/unauthorized-payment/agent.py.

Preserve the task's six-turn scenario, frozen ledger criteria, independent positive-control reset, candidate instruction defect, original agent, synthetic payment helper, and existing demo recordings. The reported static error must be resolved without relabeling this whole-agent test as a component test or removing its candidate adapter.
